p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_cfg_parser.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"data/size","code":"if (size < 50) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as a candidate config only when the input is at least 50 bytes long."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_cfg_parser.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"filename","code":"sprintf(filename, \"/tmp/libfuzzer.%d\", getpid());","note":"The fuzzer writes the attacker bytes to a temporary file and passes that file path to the parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_cfg_parser.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"filename","code":"readcfgfile(filename);","note":"The vulnerable configuration parser consumes the attacker-controlled file contents."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/haproxy/src/cfgparse.c","function":"readcfgfile","line":1870,"var":"thisline/end","code":"while (fgets(thisline + readbytes, linesize - readbytes, f) != NULL)","note":"The parser reads each config line into a heap buffer and processes it line by line."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/haproxy/src/cfgparse.c","function":"readcfgfile","line":1930,"var":"line","code":"if (*line == '[') { err_code |= cfg_parse_scope(file, linenum, line); goto next_line; }","note":"A line beginning with '[' is dispatched to the scope parser, making scope syntax attacker-controlled."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/haproxy/src/cfgparse.c","function":"cfg_parse_scope","line":1767,"var":"end","code":"end = strchr(beg, ']');","note":"The scope parser searches for a closing bracket without first bounding the search to the current line."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/haproxy/src/cfgparse.c","function":"cfg_parse_scope","line":1770,"var":"end/beg","code":"if (!end || end == beg) { ... }","note":"If no ']' exists in the current line, strchr keeps scanning past the line buffer into adjacent memory, causing the heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace updated')
